AdministerCapabilitiesSuccess.description: Successful capability administration gateway operation result.
AdministerCapabilitiesSuccess.title: AdministerCapabilitiesSuccess

AlignmentPolicy.title: AlignmentPolicy

ApiMetadata.description:
Wire-native response metadata envelope (record R20).

The v1 metadata observed by the typed UI transport; ``stale`` carries
an explicit ``stale_reason`` exactly as the frozen client mirror
validates.
ApiMetadata.title: ApiMetadata

ApiResponse.title: ApiResponse

ApiVersion.description: Wire projection of the served API semantic version (record R1).
ApiVersion.title: ApiVersionWire

ArtifactDownloadRequest.description:
Wire projection of an artifact download request (record R6).

Uncommitted artifacts and traversal attempts are denied
``ARTIFACT_ACCESS_DENIED``; the v1 ``ArtifactRangeSpec`` and the binary
``ArtifactDownloadResponse`` stay process contracts because response
bytes are a transport body, not a record.
ArtifactDownloadRequest.title: ArtifactDownloadRequestWire

AsyncJobRef.description:
Wire projection of an asynchronous job handle (record R5).

Long-running actions return a job ID immediately; the wire progress
ratio is a ``DecimalValue`` string, not a binary float.
AsyncJobRef.title: AsyncJobRefWire

AutomationCommand.description:
Wire-native presentation-neutral automation command (record R8).

UI-exported manifests dry-run identically through CLI and API; secret
values are ``SecretRef`` identities resolved explicitly before
execution, never inline payloads.
AutomationCommand.title: AutomationCommand

AutomationCommandDescriptor.description:
Nested command descriptor inside ``AutomationSchema`` (record R9).

``input_schema`` and ``output_schema`` are bounded JSON-Schema
documents, the declared extension surface of the record.
AutomationCommandDescriptor.title: AutomationCommandDescriptor

AutomationSchema.description: Wire-native published automation command schema set (record R9).
AutomationSchema.title: AutomationSchema

BrokerMarketState.description: Provider-truth quote, tick, and market-status projection.
BrokerMarketState.title: BrokerMarketState

BulkRequestToken.description:
Wire-native pinned bulk request token (record R7).

Pairs with the Analytics-owned ``BulkSelectionToken``; replay with the
same token and idempotency key never broadens scope or duplicates
mutations.
BulkRequestToken.title: BulkRequestToken

CapabilityAdministrationProjection.description:
Wire-native capability administration projection (record R14).

No secrets or credential values ever appear in the snapshot or its
component summaries.
CapabilityAdministrationProjection.title: CapabilityAdministrationProjection

CapabilityProviderSnapshot.description: Pinned provider identity and configuration evidence.
CapabilityProviderSnapshot.title: CapabilityProviderSnapshot

ComponentStateSummary.description:
Nested per-component state summary (record R14).

Inline record part of ``CapabilityAdministrationProjection``; the
feature-state literal is the Shared Contracts §4.3 core enum.
ComponentStateSummary.title: ComponentStateSummary

ConcurrencyToken.description:
Wire projection of an optimistic concurrency token (record R2).

A stale ``If-Match`` returns 412 ``VERSION_CONFLICT`` with no partial
mutation.
ConcurrencyToken.title: ConcurrencyTokenWire

CorrelationMatrix.description:
One immutable correlation matrix artifact (R7).

Changing any constituent or policy produces a different identity; the
matrix values live in the referenced artifact, not on this record.
CorrelationMatrix.title: CorrelationMatrix

CorrelationRequest.description: One versioned correlation input policy for a candidate set (R6).
CorrelationRequest.title: CorrelationRequest

DomainEvent.description: Causally linked, ordered cross-boundary event envelope.
DomainEvent.title: DomainEvent

EditProjectsRequest.title: EditProjectsRequest

EditProjectsSuccess.description: Successful project graph gateway operation result.
EditProjectsSuccess.title: EditProjectsSuccess

EventCursor.description:
Wire projection of an SSE replay cursor position (record R3).

``Last-Event-ID`` reconnect never duplicates an externally visible
transition.
EventCursor.title: EventCursorWire

EventReplayBatch.description:
Wire projection of one SSE replay batch (record R4).

Retention-expired cursors raise ``EVENT_CURSOR_EXPIRED`` and set
``is_resync_required``.
EventReplayBatch.title: EventReplayBatchWire

ExecutionAuthorityRef.description:
Reference to the selected paper or broker authority (record R11).

Cross-authority and cross-environment dispatch is structurally
impossible: a paper authority carries only the registered
paper-execution capability, and a demo/live authority carries only the
exact Broker session environment.
ExecutionAuthorityRef.title: ExecutionAuthorityRef

ExposureLimit.description:
One declared exposure limit kind with its bound and optional scope.

Nested record of ``Allocation`` (R4) and ``PortfolioConstraintSet`` (R5).
ExposureLimit.title: ExposureLimit

InstrumentRef.description: Reference to one canonical instrument identity.
InstrumentRef.title: InstrumentRef

InterfaceFailure.description:
Structured failure envelope shared by the five new Interfaces gateways.

``CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE`` performs no mutation. All five gateways
enforce identical authentication, authorization, mode/environment
gating, validation, idempotency, conflict, event, and audit semantics
across HTTP, CLI, MCP, and automation adapters (transport parity).
InterfaceFailure.title: InterfaceFailure

KillSwitchScope.description:
One hierarchical kill-switch scope identity.

An active broader scope dominates narrower clear states; the scope
hash pins the exact scope identity used by state lookups.
KillSwitchScope.title: KillSwitchScope

KillSwitchState.description:
Current kill-switch state for one exact scope.

Preflight and pre-dispatch checks read a known current version for the
exact scope; active, unknown, stale, unavailable, or version-mismatched
state blocks (fail-closed).
KillSwitchState.title: KillSwitchState

MarketCatalogueEntry.description:
Wire-native market catalogue row projection (record R23).

One projected catalogue row: identity and precision fields come from
the owning catalogue; live price fields are reserved for enrichment
and are never populated with invented values by this projection.
MarketCatalogueEntry.title: MarketCatalogueEntry

MarketTickQuote.description:
Wire-native observed quote projection (record R17).

One symbol-associated bid/ask observation projected from the owning
market-event provider; the gateway adds no invented quotes.
MarketTickQuote.title: MarketTickQuote

MarketTickSnapshot.description:
Wire-native market tick snapshot projection (record R18).

``sequence`` is the last applied provider event sequence so consumers
detect gaps; ``stale`` requires an explicit ``stale_reason`` and never
fabricates freshness.
MarketTickSnapshot.title: MarketTickSnapshot

McpOperation.description:
Wire-native MCP tool invocation (record R10).

MCP enforces identical validation, authorization, idempotency, and
audit as direct API; no raw paths, database access, compilers, or
plugin credentials cross the adapter.
McpOperation.title: McpOperation

ObserveMarketCatalogueRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated market catalogue browse request.

LIST accepts an optional continuation cursor and bounded page size.
ObserveMarketCatalogueRequest.title: ObserveMarketCatalogueRequest

ObserveMarketCatalogueSuccess.description:
Successful market catalogue browse result.

``revision`` identifies the catalogue state the page was projected
from and ``generated_at`` records the projection instant.
ObserveMarketCatalogueSuccess.title: ObserveMarketCatalogueSuccess

ObserveMarketDataEventSubscription.description:
Owner-required market observation event stream subscription.

The subscription is the delivery companion of
``interfaces.observe-market-data@1``: ``resume_event_id`` reconnects
after interruption with ordered replay/resync semantics, the bounded
symbol filter selects observed instruments, and ``replay_limit`` bounds
buffered replay.
ObserveMarketDataEventSubscription.title: ObserveMarketDataEventSubscription

ObserveMarketDataRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated market observation gateway request.

SNAPSHOT carries an optional bounded symbol filter; an empty filter
projects every buffered symbol.
ObserveMarketDataRequest.title: ObserveMarketDataRequest

ObserveMarketDataSuccess.description: Successful market observation gateway operation result.
ObserveMarketDataSuccess.title: ObserveMarketDataSuccess

OperatePortfoliosRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated portfolio operations gateway request.

VIEW, VALIDATE, and COMPARE require ``portfolio_version_id``; COMPARE
additionally requires ``compared_result_id``.
OperatePortfoliosRequest.title: OperatePortfoliosRequest

OperatePortfoliosSuccess.description: Successful portfolio operations gateway operation result.
OperatePortfoliosSuccess.title: OperatePortfoliosSuccess

OperateResearchRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated research preview gateway request.

PREVIEW requires ``manifest``.
OperateResearchRequest.title: OperateResearchRequest

OperateResearchSuccess.description: Successful research preview gateway operation result.
OperateResearchSuccess.title: OperateResearchSuccess

OperateTradingEventSubscription.description:
Owner-required trading operations event stream subscription.

The subscription is the delivery companion of
``interfaces.operate-trading@1``: ``resume_event_id`` reconnects after
interruption with ordered replay/resync semantics and ``replay_limit``
bounds buffered replay per FR-IFACE-STREAM_TRADING_EVENTS.
OperateTradingEventSubscription.title: OperateTradingEventSubscription

OperateTradingRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated trading operations gateway request.

MANAGE_SESSION requires ``session`` and ``mode``; READINESS requires
``session_ref``; PREVIEW_ACTION requires ``session_ref`` and ``plan``;
EMERGENCY requires ``reason``, ``scope``, and ``current_version``
(authenticated role, impact, and separate attestation are required by
the delegated Risk/Trading contracts); MARKET_DATA and
OPERATOR_ANALYTICS carry no operation-specific fields.
OperateTradingRequest.title: OperateTradingRequest

OperateTradingSuccess.description:
Successful trading operations gateway operation result.

``session`` is returned for MANAGE_SESSION, ``readiness`` for
READINESS, ``preview`` for PREVIEW_ACTION, ``kill_switch`` for
EMERGENCY, ``market`` for MARKET_DATA, and ``operational_journal``
with ``qualification`` for OPERATOR_ANALYTICS.
OperateTradingSuccess.title: OperateTradingSuccess

OperationalJournalArtifact.description:
One immutable derived operational-journal artifact.

Joins immutable Strategy intent/manual plans, Risk decisions, Trading
operations, annotations, and outcomes using stable identities keyed to
one source-set and policy hash.
OperationalJournalArtifact.title: OperationalJournalArtifact

OperatorQualification.description:
One operator qualification decision under a pinned profile version.

Sparse or biased evidence samples surface as ``INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE``,
never as defensible conclusions.
OperatorQualification.title: OperatorQualification

OrderedCheck.description:
One governor check at its fixed precedence position.

This is the inline ``OrderedCheck`` record of
``RiskDecision.ordered_checks``.
OrderedCheck.title: OrderedCheck

PortSpec.description: One named typed task port at a declared schema version.
PortSpec.title: PortSpec

PortfolioBuilderProjection.description:
Wire-native portfolio builder projection (record R13).

Every transport produces the same portfolio manifests and selected
results for the same versioned input.
PortfolioBuilderProjection.title: PortfolioBuilderProjection

PortfolioConstraintSet.description:
One declared portfolio constraint set (R5).

Breaches are prevented or resolved deterministically by the owning
feature; the record only freezes the declared limits.
PortfolioConstraintSet.title: PortfolioConstraintSet

PortfolioMember.description:
One constituent strategy version of a portfolio version (R3).

Admission validates date overlap, result compatibility, required
currencies, duplicate exposure, and constituent availability.
PortfolioMember.title: PortfolioMember

PortfolioResult.description:
One aggregate portfolio simulation result (R9).

Aggregate totals reconcile to constituents; ``.sqxpf`` export preserves
identities, policies, metrics, and artifacts and reproduces the
canonical portfolio hash on round-trip.
PortfolioResult.title: PortfolioResult

ProjectExpression.description:
One sandboxed deterministic project expression.

Conditions run over declared task results, counters, and variables only;
filesystem, network, clock, and undeclared access are impossible by
construction in the owning runtime, not by this wire record.
ProjectExpression.title: ProjectExpression

ProjectGraph.description:
One immutable executable task graph.

Domain assumptions: ``task_key`` values identify tasks uniquely inside
one graph, every transition endpoint must reference a declared task key,
and every transition lying on a directed cycle must carry an explicit
``cycle_bound`` so no reachable cycle is unbounded. ``GOTO`` and
``STOP_AND_START`` compile to explicit bounded transitions at runtime.
ProjectGraph.title: ProjectGraph

ProjectGraphProjection.description:
Wire-native project graph visualization projection (record R12).

A version rejected by the authoritative server validator carries its
issues and cannot be published through any transport.
ProjectGraphProjection.title: ProjectGraphProjection

ProposedAction.description:
One complete immutable proposed action bound for admission.

``intent`` embeds the complete Strategy intent or Trading manual plan
unchanged; Risk adds scope, valuation, stop, route, evidence, and the
requested risk profile without altering it.
ProposedAction.title: ProposedAction

ProtectionSet.description:
One versioned set of owned protective orders (record R19).

Protections bind an exact entry/order/position identity and never
attach to another strategy or manual action; protected quantity never
exceeds live residual quantity. Uniqueness
``(owner_identity, version)`` spans records and is store-enforced.
ProtectionSet.title: ProtectionSet

ProtectionSpec.description:
One protective-order specification inside a protection set (R19).

Inline nested record of ``ProtectionSet.protections``; not a numbered
public record itself.
ProtectionSpec.title: ProtectionSpec

ResearchBudget.description:
Bound set enforced by research budget governance.

Public record R18, defined ahead of the table order because
``ResearchManifest`` (R2) embeds it; every bound left ``None`` is
unbounded, and bound exhaustion is a runtime policy, not a record rule.
ResearchBudget.title: ResearchBudget

ResearchManifest.description:
Immutable pinned inputs of one research execution request (R2).

Equivalent requests from every entry point produce one manifest
``content_hash``; the approved preview hash must match at admission.
ResearchManifest.title: ResearchManifest

ResearchPreview.description:
Wire-native research preview and admission envelope (record R11).

Admission must supply the approved ``manifest_hash``; a mismatch or
any ``unbounded_domains`` member blocks launch.
ResearchPreview.title: ResearchPreview

RiskDecision.description:
Canonical governor decision package for one proposed action.

The governor evaluates kill switch, evidence/profile validity,
eligibility, session/news/regime constraints, stop, size,
portfolio/market limits, allocation budget, approval policy, and
capability availability in a fixed documented precedence; earlier
blocking reasons cannot be masked by later approvals.
RiskDecision.title: RiskDecision

RiskEvidenceRef.description:
Reference to one consumed cross-owner source-evidence record.

Owner schema, identity, UTC time, freshness, coverage, provenance,
explicit missingness, and exact units are validated without redefining
the source record itself.
RiskEvidenceRef.title: RiskEvidenceRef

RiskLimitResult.description:
One evaluated limit with its precedence-ordered state.

``(decision_id, precedence)`` uniqueness is enforced by the owning
store because it spans multiple result rows.
RiskLimitResult.title: RiskLimitResult

RiskProfileRef.description: Reference to one risk profile identity.
RiskProfileRef.title: RiskProfileRef

RiskSnapshot.description:
Immutable portfolio/account risk snapshot for one decision.

Pending, open, and reserved exposure are always carried explicitly and
never silently excluded; ``duplicate_treatment`` discloses the
deterministic duplicate and in-flight treatment used.
RiskSnapshot.title: RiskSnapshot

StreamEvent.description:
Wire-native ordered SSE stream frame (record R19).

The v1 frame envelope observed by the typed UI stream transport:
monotonic ``sequence``, validated ``event_type``, and an optional
``cursor`` for reconnect resume; a terminal ``error`` frame never
carries a payload.
StreamEvent.title: StreamEvent

TaskContract.description: Declared execution contract for one task type.
TaskContract.title: TaskContract

TaskDefinition.description: One task instance inside a project graph.
TaskDefinition.title: TaskDefinition

TradeIntentRef.description:
Reference to one exact Strategy intent or manual order (record R8).

Manual actions carry authenticated principal, reason, source interface,
request/correlation IDs, and explicit discretionary identity; they
cannot masquerade as Strategy signals.
TradeIntentRef.title: TradeIntentRef

TradePlan.description:
One validated immutable trade plan (record R9).

Ambiguous or mutable inputs reject before Risk review; the plan hash
pins the exact normalized content.
TradePlan.title: TradePlan

TradingActionPreview.description:
Wire-native governed trading action preview (record R15).

Commit must supply the matching ``preview_hash``; scope or preview
drift requires reconfirmation and no adapter is called directly.
TradingActionPreview.title: TradingActionPreview

TradingReadinessProjection.description:
Wire-native trading readiness projection (record R16).

Stale, unknown, or degraded state is explicit and machine-readable so
consumers can block unsafe commands; cached state is never presented
as authority.
TradingReadinessProjection.title: TradingReadinessProjection

TradingSession.description:
One durable trading session binding (record R3).

Bindings are immutable while active; changes create a new session
version. Uniqueness ``(session_id, generation)`` is enforced by the
owning store because it spans multiple session records.
TradingSession.title: TradingSession

TradingSessionRef.description: Reference to one durable trading session and its explicit mode.
TradingSessionRef.title: TradingSessionRef

TransitionEdge.description: One transition between two task keys of a project graph.
TransitionEdge.title: TransitionEdge
